summary: Master advanced ArchiCAD techniques with our professional training program. Unlock new design possibilities and boost your architectural expertise today.
lede: Advanced ArchiCAD techniques help professionals turn precise BIM models into consistent drawings, schedules, data exports, and IFC coordination packages. This course develops practical control over model setup, attributes, views, publishing sets, documentation workflows, and reusable content so teams can work with fewer downstream corrections. You will practise model auditing, layout and publisher control, IFC property mapping, GDL content planning, and delivery reporting. The course also guides you in creating a documentation pack, model audit checklist, reusable content standard, coordination plan, and delivery roadmap for repeatable project delivery.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already use ArchiCAD and need stronger control over advanced modeling, documentation, and BIM exchange workflows. It fits people who are responsible for producing clean project output, coordinating model data, and keeping office standards aligned across active jobs.
modules: ArchiCAD model health and data control
prerequisites: You will need a laptop with ArchiCAD installed and access to the course practice files. You should bring familiarity with BIM project views, layouts, attributes, and basic documentation workflows, plus a willingness to work through model audits, publication tasks, and exchange exercises during the course.
